notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
In this update, you are waiting for such changes and innovations:
Previously, some cameras have been placed in such positions that when using VR - users can not see the screen. - Corrected.
Removed invisible objects on the level.
Fixed achievement.
Added pause menu.

Stay with us and participate in the development of the project, together with the developer!

notes.title: Explanation of the project
notes.notes:
Although the project is listed as "complete", we are still working on the game.
The game may be present bugs.

At this point in the game is only one level, which demonstrated the mechanics of movement, shooting and zombie AI.
We will soon release an update that will bring the game scene mode with the full mechanics of the game.

Thank you for attention. VRSpeс team.
